pricing_basis.description: Freight per consignment is the sum of a weight component (₹6.00 per kg of billed weight) and a distance component (₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance).

service_level_rules.note: Only standard service is offered under this agreement.

premiums.name: Cold chain premium
premiums.condition: Consignment is booked as cold chain (travels in a refrigerated vehicle)

accessorial_policy.note: The contract does not name any accessorial charges or state any restriction on what accessorials may be billed.

exclusions.condition: The c-note number on an invoice line cannot be matched to a Customer booking
exclusions.description: Invoice lines whose consignment note (c-note) number cannot be matched to a Customer booking are not payable until reconciled.

rounding_rule.note: The contract does not state any rounding rule for computed charges.

ambiguities.description: Clause 4 states invoices are issued 'as trips are pooled, typically fortnightly' -- the actual invoicing cycle/period is described only as typical, not fixed, so the exact invoicing boundary dates are indeterminate.

Clause 5's non-payability rule for unmatched c-note lines depends on a booking-match/join outcome, which is not expressible via any of the available shipment attributes (service_level, special_handling, billed_weight_kg, distance_km), so no structured trigger could be encoded for this exclusion.

Clause 1's distance component is rated on 'booked lane distance', which is not explicitly defined as identical to a shipment record's actual/measured distance_km; if booked lane distance can differ from recorded distance, which value to rate against is ambiguous.

notes: Clause 6 permits the Carrier to issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices, referencing the original c-note and invoice; this is a billing-process rule rather than a pricing rule and has no rate-card representation.
No rate bands, no chargeable weight floor, and no weight/distance-threshold exclusions are stated anywhere in this contract.
